The IDs or values of the recipient items. The type of items depends on the type of recipient.

                            - 2: Assigned technicians

                            - 22: Manager of the observer group

                            - 24: Assigned group members, excluding managers
                            - 25: Requester group members, excluding managers
                            - 26: Observer group members, excluding managers

                            - 2: Email
                            - 3: LDAP
                            - 4: External
                            - 5: CAS
                            - 6: X.509 Certificate

language.description: Language code (POSIX compliant format e.g. en_US or fr_FR)

name_format.description:
- 0: Surname First name
                        - 1: First name Surname

use_flat_dropdowntree.description: Display the tree dropdown complete name in dropdown inputs

use_flat_dropdowntree_on_search_result.description: Display the complete name of tree dropdown in search results

show_new_tickets_on_home.description: Show new tickets on the home page

priority_color_verylow.description: Hex color code for very low priority

priority_color_low.description: Hex color code for low priority

priority_color_medium.description: Hex color code for medium priority

priority_color_high.description: Hex color code for high priority

priority_color_veryhigh.description: Hex color code for very high priority

priority_color_major.description: Hex color code for major priority

refresh_view_interval.description: Auto-refresh interval for tickets list, kanbans, and dashboards in minutes

set_default_tech.description: Pre-select me as a technician when creating a ticket

set_default_requester.description: Pre-select me as a requester when creating a ticket

set_followup_tech.description: Add me as a technician when adding a ticket followup

set_solution_tech.description: Add me as a technician when adding a ticket solution

home_list_limit.description: Results to display on home page

duedate_color_ok.description: Hex color code for on-time due dates

duedate_color_warning.description: Hex color code for warning due dates

duedate_color_critical.description: Hex color code for overdue due dates

keep_devices_when_purging_item.description: Keep linked devices when purging an item

show_new_item_after_creation.description: Go to created item after creation

default_task_state.description:
Default state for new tasks
                        - 1: Information
                        - 2: To do
                        - 3: Done

default_task_state_planned.description:
Default state for new planned tasks
                        - 1: Information
                        - 2: To do
                        - 3: Done

timeline_order.description:
- 0: Natural order (oldest first)
                        - 1: Reverse order (newest first)

richtext_layout.description:
- inline: Toolbar displays at the cursor position and some options in right-click menu
                        - classic: Toolbar displays at the top of the text area

directunlock_notification.description: Direct Notification (requester for unlock will be the notification sender)

default_homepage_tab.description:
Default homepage tab
                        - 0: Dashboard
                        - 1: Personal view
                        - 2: Group view
                        - 3: Global view
                        - 4: RSS feeds

timeline_action_button_layout.description:
Timeline action buttons layout
                        - 0: Merged
                        - 1: Split

timeline_date_format.description:
Timeline date format
                        - 0: Relative (e.g. "2 hours ago")
                        - 1: Absolute (e.g. "2025-01-01 14:00")

default_is_notifications_enabled.description: Enable notifications by default. If disabled, notifications on tickets, change and problems can be optionally enabled as needed but other items will not send notifications at all

mount_point.description: The mount point of the volume, e.g. /home

encryption_status.description:
Encryption status of the volume:
                            - 0: No encryption
                            - 1: Fully encrypted
                            - 2: Partially encrypted

use_default_payload.description: If true, the entire JSON output from the API for the item will be used

custom_headers.description: JSON encoded object containing custom headers to add to the webhook request. The header names and values are Twig templates that can use any property of the item as a variable.

url.description: The URL to send the webhook request to. This is a Twig template that can use any property of the item as a variable.

secret.description: A secret value that can be shared with a target server to allow it to validate requests are actually coming from the GLPI server and that the content was not modified between GLPI and the target.

use_cra_challenge.description: Whether to use a Challenge-Response Authentication mechanism to validate the target server.

sent_try.description: The number of times this webhook will try to be sent.

save_response_body.description: If true and if response saving is globally allowed (disabled by default), the response body of the webhook request will be saved in the queued webhook data. This is only intended for debugging purposes.

log_in_item_history.description: Whether to log webhook calls in the related item's history.

use_oauth.description: Whether to use OAuth 2.0 authentication when sending the webhook request.

oauth_url.description: The URL to obtain the OAuth 2.0 access token.
